_doc: Committed mutation-survivor ratchet for the weekly `mutants` workflow (.github/workflows/mutants.yml, ADR-0031). Each key below is a crate whose surviving-mutant count is FROZEN at `max_survivors`: the sweep fails and opens a tracking issue when `just mutants -p <crate>` reports MORE survivors than the committed number — i.e. a test that used to catch a mutant no longer does. A crate ABSENT from this file is swept report-only (never red) until it is reinforced and given an entry, mirroring ADR-0031's per-crate 'advisory, then blocking once the baseline is clean'. Lower an entry as survivors are killed to tighten the ratchet; never raise one to hide a real regression.

aozora-spec.reason: Two provably-equivalent mutants in Span::shift_clamp — crates/aozora-spec/src/span.rs:105 (`<` -> `<=`) and :107 (`>` -> `>=`). They differ from the original only at `shifted == 0` and `shifted == u32::MAX` respectively, where both comparisons yield the identical clamp, so no input can distinguish them. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: skip is function-granular and would also silence the killable `>` -> `==` sibling on the same function. See PR #482.

aozora-syntax.reason: Three provably-equivalent mutants, each a comparison the mutation cannot change on any reachable input. (1) crates/aozora-syntax/src/accent.rs:414 and (2) :463 turn `while i < bytes.len()` into `<=` in decompose_fragment / decompose_fragment_edits: the extra i==bytes.len() iteration calls try_match (None past the end), then `fragment.get(i..)` yields Some("") whose `.chars().next()` is None, so the loop breaks immediately without pushing a char or an edit — output identical. (3) crates/aozora-syntax/src/format.rs:46 turns `self.0.get() > 0` into `>= 0` in FontShift::larger, but the field is NonZeroI8 so 0 is unconstructible and the two comparisons agree on every value. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also carries KILLABLE sibling mutants (e.g. larger()'s `>` -> `<` / `==`, already caught) that a function-granular skip would silence too. Confirmed 3-missed on both the container and host lanes. See #485.

aozora-encoding.reason: Five equivalent/unreachable mutants in crates/aozora-encoding/src/gaiji.rs, all confirmed un-killable after the crate's other 27 survivors were killed (host+container parity: 225 mutants -> 5 missed). (1) parse_menkuten:520:31 `||`->`&&`: the trailing `mkt.to_string() == token` round-trip guard only accepts input where both operands of that `||` are already false (exactly three parts AND level==plane+2), so `A||B` and `A&&B` are both false on every accepted input and both yield None on every rejected one. (2,3) resolve_at:719:43 `>`->`==` and `>`->`>=`: the guard `body_end > source.len()` is unreachable-true — `source.get(start..end)?` above guarantees end<=len and body_end = end - GAIJI_CLOSE.len() < end, so the clause is always false and all three comparisons agree (an intentional defensive check). (4) snap_to_char_boundary_left:818:15 `>`->`>=`: differs from `>` only at idx==0, where `!is_char_boundary(0)` is always false so the `&&` stops the loop regardless. (5) snap_to_char_boundary_right:826:15 `<`->`<=`: symmetric at idx==len (the end index is always a boundary). Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings (already caught) a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.

aozora-scan.reason: Clean after reinforcement. The two OffsetSink::reserve stubs (Vec + BumpVec impls) are killed by capacity assertions in trait_def.rs. The perf-only `prewarm` (deleting its body only defers the idempotent automaton build — no observable output) and the cfg-dead no_std `scan_into` (not built under the default `std` sweep) are `#[cfg_attr(test, mutants::skip)]`ped with in-source reasons — untestable-by-nature, not hidden gaps. 0 survivors on both the host and container lanes. See #485.

aozora-veb.reason: Clean with no reinforcement needed: every viable mutant in the Eytzinger / van-Emde-Boas lookup layer is already caught by the suite (host + container both report 0 missed). The ~12 timeouts are unbounded-loop mutations of the bounded search loops that the 30s hang-timeout kills — they are not survivors and the ratchet does not count them. See #485.

aozora-pipeline.reason: 39 equivalent/unreachable mutants confirmed un-killable after the crate's 365 killable survivors were killed (host + container: 484 -> 39 missed; enumeration is 1031 not 1111 because the cfg-dead classify-instrument module is excluded in mutants.toml). The re-swept survivor set is EXACTLY these 39 (zero stragglers). Categories: (a) boundary comparisons (`<` -> `<=`, `>` -> `>=`) whose only added case is an empty-slice no-op at cursor==len (sanitize.rs line-ending / decorative-rule / accent walks; mod.rs build_content_from_body at events.end, a non-candidate PairClose); (b) `&&`/`||` swaps over operands an internal invariant keeps always-true (sanitize.rs neutralize_sentinel_collisions — the diagnostics are generated internally on the same buffer so their spans are always in-bounds and char-aligned); (c) arithmetic on `open_idx`, which is 0 at every call site, so `+1` / `*1` / `-` leaves the reading/content window.bytes unchanged and only shifts an event-range start onto a non-candidate event (mod.rs recognize_ruby / try_ruby_emit / try_angle_quote_emit / try_emit_gaiji_at / try_emit_annotation_at); (d) three `#[cfg(feature="classify-instrument")]` counter comparisons in pending_outputs_pop_front, cfg-dead under the default-feature sweep; (e) state writes that are never read after the EOF Unclosed drain, and match-guard/arm mutations over patterns an upstream `!is_empty()` filter makes unreachable (mod.rs handle_stream_event / classify_forward_heading; forward.rs; directive.rs prewarm; pipeline.rs; offset.rs; tokenize.rs). Full per-mutant proofs are in the PR body. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings (now caught) a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.

aozora-render.reason: 3 equivalent mutants confirmed after the crate's 188 killable survivors were killed (host: 190 -> 3 missed, including one caught->missed straggler `TrackingWriter::last -> None` that the fan-out missed and a direct assertion re-killed). (1,2) walk.rs:89 and :99 replace the WalkSink default methods on_newline / finish with `Ok(Default::default())`; both default bodies return `Ok(())` and `<() as Default>::default()` is `()`, so the payloads are bit-identical. (3) spelling/html.rs:271 `<` -> `<=` in escape_text_chunk: at cursor==pos (the only added case, since cursor is never > pos) the body writes chunk[pos..pos], an empty-slice write_str no-op. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.
